realNumbers.reconciliationWithTheOldCirculatingNumbe: The old 22.22%% figure (38,444/173,050) and the true gate arithmetic (38,197/172,803 = 22.10%%) are numerically close but NOT the same computation, and the closeness is coincidental. rollN=173,050 (pre-bake readiness event, this same run) is the UNION of all distinct prop_ids across both tax years (172,116 @2025 + 134,606 @2026 - 133,672 in both = 173,050), not the 2026 roll. The old numerator (38,444) is 'prop_ids present in cad_property at 2025 with no row at 2026' counted without excluding zero-dollar rows; the true numerator (38,197) is that same population minus exactly 247 rows that carry no dollar in any field (which CADROLL_EXPECTATION_SQL's own ABSENCE carve-out correctly excludes). 173,050-172,803=247 and 38,444-38,197=247, both reconciled exactly, zero unexplained residual.

criticalCorrectionToTheDispatch.theNuanceThatReconcilesBothLanes: CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's 'no CAD signal' label rested on assessed_value / exemption_codes / living_area_sqft -- none of which StratMap's TxGIO mapper ever populates (legacy-design-tools @ 65f924e8, lib/cad-ingest/src/txgio/landuse.ts:143-146: landValue/improvementValue/marketValue ARE read straight from the shapefile's own LAND_VALUE/IMP_VALUE/MKT_VALUE attributes; only assessedValue is hardcoded null). Those three fields are exactly what satisfies CADROLL_EXPECTATION_SQL's OR test. So the 'geometry-only' population is not actually dollar-free -- it carries land/market/improvement figures sourced from TxGIO's own parcel attributes (themselves CAD-derived upstream, per the StratMap/TxGIO program's design, just via a different distribution channel than Hays' own tabular export). Both lanes' underlying measurements are correct; the dispatch's inference that the two populations must be disjoint was the wrong inference, not a bad count.
criticalCorrectionToTheDispatch.whyThisMattersButDoesNotChangeTheFix: The severity/urgency framing changes (this is overwhelmingly the already-flagged geometry-only population, not a fresh 'real account' defect), and CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's still-open operator question about that population's honest absence state becomes directly relevant here too. But the CODE-LEVEL mechanism and fix location are the same regardless of framing: CADROLL_EXPECTATION_SQL's missing tax-year scope produces a false 'expected' classification for any dollar-bearing row absent from the declared current vintage, whether that dollar came from a genuine CAD export or from TxGIO's StratMap attributes.

Whichever lane implements this should verify that assumption holds for every CTX county before relying on it, or take option (a).

lessons: LESSON: A gate's refusal detail (sampled/compared/misses/examples) recorded only via a success-path event write is invisible on the refusal path itself if the throw happens before the write -- bastrop-publish.mjs:436-437 calls cadRollFn then recordCadRollEvent in sequence, so a refusal from cadRollFn skips the record entirely. Any future postcondition of this shape should record its verdict (pass OR refuse) in a finally-equivalent path, or the run record will only ever carry a bare code string on the exact failures that most need the detail.

LESSON: 'no CAD signal' classifications built from a specific field allowlist (assessed_value/exemption_codes/living_area_sqft in CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's case) can miss a different field (land_value/market_value/improvement_value here) that the same non-CAD source DOES populate. Before declaring a population 'dollar-free' or 'signal-free,' check every field the next consumer's own predicate actually tests, not just the fields chosen for the current investigation's discriminator.

LESSON: two dispatches working the same underlying population from different angles (CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's absence-state question, CTX-HAYS-GATE's postcondition question) can each be individually correct in their own measurements and still produce a wrong combined inference (disjointness) if neither lane cross-checks the other's already-published numbers against its own new population. [[project_hauska_ctx_pipeline_architecture]] -- worth a durable note that P-124 lanes touching Hays 48209 should grep _inbox/ for prior close artifacts on the same county before asserting a population is novel or disjoint from a prior lane's.
